verdict.rationale: Browserbase documents deploying and running browser agents on its own platform, on a schedule or on demand, and hosts browser sessions at scale, so developers avoid managing browser infrastructure. Agent runs can also be converted into reusable Stagehand scripts. However, the evidence does not explicitly show that arbitrary developer-written scraping scripts can be uploaded and executed serverlessly. Missing for 10: explicit docs on deploying custom code/scripts (not just agents) to Browserbase runtime, details on the deployment workflow and runtime limits, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build and deploy custom serverless scraping scripts on the platform without managing my own infrastructure

citations.quote: Deploy and run browser agents on Browserbase, on a schedule or on demand.
Use the Optimize tool to turn a completed Agent run into a reusable Stagehand script.
Spin up thousands of concurrent browser sessions and return answers immediately
